content: CRAN requires network-using packages to fail gracefully with an informative message when the network is unavailable, producing 0 ERRORs/WARNINGs/NOTEs in R CMD check. For examples use @examplesIf interactive() && nchar(Sys.getenv('API_KEY',''))>0 (roxygen2 7.1.2+) or \dontrun{}. For tests use skip_on_cran() + skip_if(key=='','No key'). For vignettes use eval = identical(Sys.getenv('BUILD_VIGNETTE'),'true') and pre-build. The is_available_provider() helper gates all API calls at runtime and returns NULL + message() when unavailable.
